entries.en: to submit; to return to, to attach oneself (Sp. reducirse)

entries.zh: 归并为一；把众多事物归总到一起
entries.en: to be brought together into one; to reduce many things to unity

entries.zh: 走上归正之路；归向德行（字面：行归路）
entries.en: to walk the road back; to turn to the way of virtue
entries.notes: 第三个音节存疑（guiā/ǔiā），当取“行”之行走义，故“归路行”解作行归路、走回头路。

entries.zh: 归并成一伙；与同伴合为一群
entries.en: to merge into one company; to join together with one's comrades
entries.notes: 汉字“歸併〔佐/作〕一夥”中一字存疑，音写 chǒ 指向“做/作”，义据西语 camaradas 与“一夥”定。

entries.zh: 煎炼；以火提炼金属（如炼金）
entries.en: to refine (metal, as gold) by fire; to smelt, to decoct
to roast, to bake (ore) in refining; to calcine

entries.zh: 有上尉衔而无实职的改编军官（reformado）
entries.en: a reformado — an officer kept without command, here holding a captain's rank
entries.notes: reformado 为17世纪军政术语（降编留衔）；汉字“無椿”与音写无从系联，末段 sungobiērn 疑为西语（sin/su gobierno）混入，故降为低置信。

entries.en: to rub with the hands; to scrub
entries.notes: 汉字（捝/捛）与音写（gur/cur）皆残损存疑，义据西语 refregar 定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕用手搓揉、搓擦
entries.en: [original damaged — gloss uncertain] to rub with the hands, to scrub
entries.notes: 汉字“跣/踠”与“搓揉”义不相应，音写仅一污损音节 xue，释义只能据西语词头。

entries.en: to wash by rubbing; to scrub with the hands
entries.notes: 音写 xiū 与“洗”之常读不合，字形存疑（洗/澡），义据西语词头。

entries.zh: 忌口；节制饮食（亦指管住嘴、不多言）
entries.en: to curb the mouth: to abstain from certain foods; to keep silence

entries.zh: 犒赏士兵；给士兵的慰劳（赏钱或酒食）
entries.en: a reward or refreshment for the soldiers; to reward the troops
entries.notes: 汉字栏作“詰/誥”不可解；R 栏实为西语同义词 premiar、galardonar（奖赏），音写 cô nang 疑即“犒人”，字形待核。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕抚爱；亲昵地抚弄（regalar 兼有赠予、款待义）
entries.en: [original damaged — gloss uncertain] to caress, to fondle; (regalar) to give, to treat kindly
entries.notes: 汉字（態/慈）与音写（im/um xum）均残损难辨，释义仅据西语 regalar/acariciar。

entries.zh: 款待客人；待客（以礼相待、赠礼）
entries.en: to entertain a guest, to treat a guest well; to give gifts to a guest
entries.notes: 音写并列三种说法（wan tay / teng tay / gezü-nü）而后段残损；汉字“待”明确，义据词头定。
